name: Kusunose Saaya
source:
The protagonist's other childhood friend and also [url=/c43545]Miku's[/url] best friend.
A cool-headed and smart girl who can be often spotted with a book in her hands, not to mention she is also a member of the library committee.
She is also skilled in aikido because she has been trained by her grandfather in it.
Despite her piercing eyes, she loves cute things and often spoils Miku due to this.
